title: ISS securities: engines/futures/markets/options
description: Architecture only — disabled by default (config/market_source.yaml options.enabled=false). ISS returns ~37k rows / ~13MB for this market (one row per strike per expiration), which the daily refresh, the in-memory pool and the frontend cannot absorb without pagination and a strike filter; that is separate follow-up work. Written now so instrument_type='option' and the options_series channel have a real shape to target instead of a guess.
